es: Transformar frases entre registro informal y formal: verbos frasales por verbos formales, sin contracciones y con pasiva, y viceversa.

teaching.en: We regret to inform you that the meeting has been postponed until further notice, and we apologise for any inconvenience this may cause.
teaching.es: Lamentamos informarle de que la reunión ha sido aplazada hasta nuevo aviso, y pedimos disculpas por cualquier molestia que esto pueda causar.
teaching.explanationEs: Formal: regret to inform + pasiva (has been postponed) + apologise; sin contracciones.
segments: We regret to inform you that the meeting has been postponed until
further notice, and we apologise for any inconvenience this may cause.
teaching.audioText: We regret to inform you that the meeting has been postponed until further notice, and we apologise for any inconvenience this may cause.

teaching.en: In an informal message you might simply say: sorry, we've put off the meeting, but we'll get back to you with a new date next week.
teaching.es: En un mensaje informal podrías decir simplemente: perdona, hemos aplazado la reunión, pero te diremos una nueva fecha la semana que viene.
teaching.explanationEs: Informal: contracciones, sorry y los verbos frasales put off y get back to.
segments: In an informal message you might simply say: sorry, we've put off the
meeting, but we'll get back to you with a new date next week.
teaching.audioText: In an informal message you might simply say: sorry, we've put off the meeting, but we'll get back to you with a new date next week.

teaching.en: Applicants who require further details can obtain the application form from the school office, where our staff will assist them.
teaching.es: Los solicitantes que necesiten más información pueden obtener el formulario en la secretaría del colegio, donde nuestro personal les ayudará a presentarlo.
teaching.explanationEs: Require = need, obtain = get, assist = help: verbos de origen latino, propios del registro formal.
segments: Applicants who require further details can obtain the application form
from the school office, where our staff will assist them.
teaching.audioText: Applicants who require further details can obtain the application form from the school office, where our staff will assist them.

teaching.en: The informal version would read: if you need more details, you can get the form from the office, hand in your application there, and the staff will help you.
teaching.es: La versión informal diría: si necesitas más información, puedes conseguir el formulario en la oficina, entregar allí tu solicitud y el personal te ayudará.
teaching.explanationEs: Informal: if you need, you can get, hand in y help: verbos cortos y trato directo de tú.
segments: The informal version would read: if you need more details, you can get the form
from the office, hand in your application there, and the staff will help you.
teaching.audioText: The informal version would read: if you need more details, you can get the form from the office, hand in your application there, and the staff will help you.

teaching.en: Formal writing prefers the passive, which sounds impersonal, and avoids contractions, so «We had to turn down your offer» becomes «Your offer has regrettably been declined».
teaching.es: La escritura formal prefiere la pasiva, que suena impersonal, y evita las contracciones: «Tuvimos que rechazar su oferta» pasa a «Su oferta ha sido declinada, lamentablemente».
teaching.explanationEs: Turn down (frasal) → decline (formal); la pasiva oculta quién decide.
segments: Formal writing prefers the passive, which sounds impersonal, and avoids contractions, so «We
had to turn down your offer» becomes «Your offer has regrettably been declined».
teaching.audioText: Formal writing prefers the passive, which sounds impersonal, and avoids contractions, so «We had to turn down your offer» becomes «Your offer has regrettably been declined».

teaching.en: Beware of false friends: assist means to help, so to go to a meeting you must say attend, never assist.
teaching.es: Cuidado con los falsos amigos: assist significa ayudar; para ir a una reunión hay que decir attend, nunca assist.
teaching.explanationEs: Assist ≠ asistir a un evento: asistir a una reunión es attend.
segments: Beware of false friends: assist means to help, so to
go to a meeting you must say attend, never assist.
teaching.audioText: Beware of false friends: assist means to help, so to go to a meeting you must say attend, never assist.

prompt.es: Elige la versión formal que conserva todo el sentido del aviso.

choices.text: We regret to inform you that the school trip has been postponed until Monday, as many students are ill.
We regret to inform you that the school trip has been cancelled until Monday, as many students are ill.
We are sorry to tell you that we've postponed the school trip until Monday, as many students are ill.

feedback.es: La versión formal mantiene «aplazada» (no cancelada), usa la pasiva y elimina contracciones y jerga.

hint.es: Comprueba el verbo que traduce put off y que no queden contracciones.

origin.text: Hi all, we've put off the school trip until Monday because so many students are ill. Sorry about that, and cheers for understanding!

prompt.es: Completa (formal): «El personal ayudará a quien necesite el formulario.»

feedback.es: En registro formal, help se sustituye por assist: our staff will assist anyone…

hint.es: Verbo formal de origen latino que significa ayudar.

origin.text: All visitors must report to reception first. Our staff will ___ anyone who needs help with the registration form.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Lamentamos informarle de que la conferencia ha sido aplazada.»

answer.text: We regret to inform you that the conference has been postponed

feedback.es: La fórmula We regret to inform you that… va seguida de una oración en pasiva y sin contracciones.

hint.es: Empieza por We regret y termina con el participio postponed.

prompt.es: Pasa a registro formal el mensaje sobre la oferta rechazada.

answer.text: We regret to inform you that your offer has been declined. We apologise and will consider other options.
accepted: We regret to inform you that your offer has been declined. We apologise and will consider other options.
We regret to inform you that your offer has been declined. We apologize and will consider other options.
We regret to inform you that we have declined your offer. We apologise and will consider other options.
We regret to inform you that your offer has been turned down. We apologise and will consider other options.

feedback.es: El mensaje formal usa la fórmula regret to inform, la pasiva declined y apologise, sin contracciones.

origin.text: We've turned down your offer, I'm afraid. Sorry, we'll look into other options.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada verbo formal con el verbo informal al que sustituye.

feedback.es: Cada verbo formal de origen latino tiene un equivalente corto o frasal en el registro coloquial.

prompt.es: Elige la versión formal del aviso sobre el taller del viernes.

choices.text: We have cancelled Friday's workshop because the speaker is ill. We'll announce a new date soon and apologise.
Friday's workshop has been postponed because the speaker is ill. A new date will be confirmed shortly. We apologise.
Friday's workshop has been postponed because the speaker's ill, and we are sorry. A new date will be announced.

feedback.es: Solo una versión mantiene el aplazamiento, usa la pasiva y evita contracciones y disculpas informales.

origin.text: Hi everyone, we've had to put off Friday's workshop because the speaker is ill. We'll sort out a new date soon and let you know. Sorry about the mix-up!

prompt.es: Escucha el aviso y elige la versión informal que resume su mensaje.

choices.text: Sorry, we've cancelled Thursday's meeting as the hall is needed for an exam, but you can still pick up the agenda at reception.
Sorry, we've put off Thursday's meeting until next week as the hall is needed for an exam, and we'll post the agenda to everybody.
Sorry, we've put off Thursday's meeting until next week as the hall is needed for an exam; you can pick up the agenda at reception.

feedback.es: La versión fiel mantiene el aplazamiento una semana y que la agenda se recoge en recepción, con verbos frasales.

origin.audio: Good morning, everyone. This is a short notice from the school office. We regret to inform you that Thursday's parents' meeting has been postponed until the following week, as the hall is required for an exam. Parents who wish to obtain a copy of the agenda may collect it from reception, where our staff will be pleased to assist them. We apologise for any inconvenience.

prompt.es: Pasa a informal: «Students who require further help with the application…»

answer.text: If you need help with the application, tell the office right away.
accepted: If you need help with the application, tell the office right away.
If you need help with your application, let the office know straight away.
If you need help with the application, tell the office straight away.
If you need some help with the application, let the office know right away.

feedback.es: Pasar a informal exige verbos cortos (need, help, tell) y un trato directo de tú.

origin.text: Students who require further help with the application should inform the office immediately.

prompt.es: Completa: «Lamentamos tener que rechazar su petición.»

feedback.es: Decline es el verbo formal que sustituye al frasal turn down al rechazar una petición por escrito.

origin.text: In a formal letter, «we had to turn down your request» is better expressed as «we regret that we must ___ your request».

prompt.es: ¿Qué efecto produce la pasiva en este aviso formal?

choices.text: It does not say who made the decision, so the message sounds impersonal and distant.
It makes the writer sound warm and personally involved in the decision itself.
It shows that the writer is unsure about what has been decided so far.

feedback.es: La pasiva omite al agente: nadie «decide», y el mensaje suena impersonal y distante.

origin.text: It has been decided that your request cannot be accepted. You are required to leave the room by noon.

prompt.es: ¿Con qué fin se incluye la última frase del aviso?

choices.text: To admit that the organisers have made a serious mistake.
To soften the bad news and show respect for the readers.
To ask the readers to keep their tickets safe for a year.

feedback.es: La disculpa final cumple una función de cortesía: suaviza la mala noticia sin reconocer un error concreto.

origin.text: We regret to inform you that the concert has been postponed until further notice. Tickets will remain valid, and staff will assist anyone who requires help. We apologise for any inconvenience.

prompt.es: Completa: «Solo quienes asistan a la conferencia recibirán un certificado.»

feedback.es: Asistir a un evento es attend; assist significa ayudar y aquí cambiaría el sentido de la frase.

origin.text: Our staff will assist the visitors, but only those who ___ the conference on Friday will receive a certificate.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Los solicitantes pueden obtener el formulario en la oficina.»

answer.text: Applicants can obtain the form from the office

feedback.es: Obtain es el verbo formal de get; se construye con from para indicar dónde se consigue.
